newsitem.title: USA: DuPont Merck gets UK breast imaging approval.
newsitem.headline: DuPont Merck gets UK breast imaging approval.

text.p: DuPont Merck, a joint venture of DuPont Co and Merck & Co Inc, said Monday that its application for a breast imaging indication for Technetium Tc-99m Sestamibi has received approval in the United Kingdom.

The company said that the U.K. Medicines Control Agency cleared the product for marketing as a second line diagnostic aid in the investigation of patients with suspected breast cancer when the results of mammography are unsatisfactory or equivocal.

A supplemental new drug application (sNDA) containing the same clinical trials data was filed with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration in December of 1995, and DuPont Merck is awaiting approval in the United States.
Approvals have been granted in Denmark, Switzerland and Hungary.
Tc-99m Sestamibi is currently marketed in Europe by DuPont Merck under the trade name Cardiolite for use in heart imaging.
DuPont Merck markets its products under the DuPont Pharma name.
